term: shared group record for fact grounds versus causal exercise
resolution: The existing polymorphic record structure is reused for joint fact-ground antecedent lists; this does not identify facts with physical events or ground with efficient causation. Both contributor and enabler fields are included in members, avoiding a hidden condition omission. No Exercise, occurs, allowed-scenario sufficiency or graph source predicate is used. The autonomy predicate is a source-motivated open classification, not self-causation, intrinsic productive power or a necessary-bearer definition. Positive and essential labels remain distinct and uninterpreted beyond their tags.
